newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela signs pay deal with high school teachers.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela signs pay deal with high school teachers.

text.p: Venezuela's Education Minsiter Antonio Luis Cardenas said Wednesday he had reached an agreement with Venezuela's 108,000 high school and primary teachers over pay increases for the coming year.
"It's a big jump that takes you over 100 percent, but there was a large backlog and this was an act of jutice," he told reporters.
The accord does not include Venezuela's 40,000 University professors, currently in their fifth week of strikes over a 125 percent pay increase claim.

Cardenas said the agreement, which comes on the heels of a wider public sector pay accord announced late Tuesday, took total budgeted spending on primary and secondary techers' pay to 515 billion bolivars ($1.1 billion).

National teachers union Fenatev president Ronald Golding told Reuters he was not able to say how much the increase was in average percentage terms as the rises were granted according to a sliding scale.
